name: familyofx
description: Read a FamilyOFX organisation and queue changes for approval in FamilyOFX.

interface.longDescription: FamilyOFX connects ChatGPT and Codex to one family office organisation you approve at sign-in. Ask for a portfolio summary, holdings, documents, contacts, tasks, deals, and calendar. Read tools return live data for that organisation. Create and update tools do not change records until you accept the pending action in FamilyOFX under AI Agents. The connector cannot move money, delete the office, or open an organisation you did not connect.
defaultPrompt: Summarise the portfolio in this family office.
Find documents about the latest capital call.
List open tasks for this office.

positive.description: Portfolio summary on the connected organisation
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_portfolio_summary and report the result. The review organisation may have no holdings yet. An empty summary is a success, not a failed call.
Call positions and list the largest holdings, or say there are none if the organisation is empty.

positive.prompt: Find documents about a capital call.
positive.expected_behavior: Search documents and return matches, or say none were found. Do not invent a document.
List tasks on the connected organisation, or say there are none.

positive.description: Create a task queues an approval
positive.prompt: Create a task to call the bank about a capital call.
positive.expected_behavior: Queue a pending approval in FamilyOFX. Tell the reviewer to accept it under AI Agents. Do not claim the task already exists.

negative.prompt: Delete every document in the office.
Show the portfolio of a different family office I did not connect.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial FamilyOFX connector. Reads run live. Writes wait for approval in FamilyOFX.
